calls.prompt: Redesign this same bartender as a brass night train conductor: angular peaked conductor cap, short burgundy double-breasted jacket with broad structured lapels, two rows of brass buttons and a small curved pocket-watch chain, tailored dark trousers and black shoes. Keep the same face, three-head-tall proportions, exact right-facing three-quarter side pose, empty hands at exactly the same positions, same feet and canvas placement, crisp pixel art and upper-left lighting. No weapon, no drink, no text, no background.
calls.deviations: Raw added an unrequested sword. Production native retains the actual generated cap and authors the jacket/lapels/chain; original empty hands and feet are preserved.
